newsitem.title: UK: UK's Berkeley sees long term steady growth.
newsitem.headline: UK's Berkeley sees long term steady growth.

text.p: British housebuilder and property developer Berkeley Group Plc said on Thursday that given the current strength of the housing market it was looking forward to long term steady growth.
It said that the improvement in the housing market continued throughout the year and was not even slowed by the run-up to the UK election in May.

Berkeley said that by the end of the financial year, it had forward sales of 491 million stg. The company likes to sell homes at an early stage, often before they are built, to eliminate some of the risk at the development stage.

Berkeley earlier announced that pretax profits for the year to April 30, 1997 had climbed 73 percent to 75.1 milllion pounds. The group raised its total dividend payout 13.1 percent to 9.5p per share, which is covered five times by earnings.
Shares in the company were 6p higher at 724p following the results announcement.
